notes.title: Level Editor (Beta)
notes.content:
Hi! 

It's been a long time since the last update, but we haven't wasted that time. I'm happy to announce the [b]open beta of the level editor[/b], an update that many of you have been waiting for. 

[h3]How to join the beta testing?[/h3]

1. Right click on the game name in your Steam Library, select 'Properties...'
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45039059/158f1ec716a0f69d2ed17b540e754561fc108fd9.png[/img]

2. Click on 'Betas' and type in the password to acces the Beta testing. The password is [b]OnionsAreCool[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45039059/5325dc0c82aeb3e0a688dab895005adb0c741e0e.png[/img]

3. Click on 'Check Code' and select the version you want to play from the dropdown menu in the top-right corner.

4. Have fun ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Added Steam Achievements
notes.content:
Hi! To anybody who is reading this.

In this update we've integrated the game with Steam, added achievements (doh) and fixed some minor bugs. There are currently eleven achievements in the game, but if you have any ideas for easter eggs and/or new achievements, feel free to join our discord server and share them!

We are still working on the level editor, which will be released on Steam this month (hopefully). We're also planning to do some rebranding soon, so we'll probably change the name and logo of our studio.

notes.title: Added Controller support
notes.content:
Hello everyone

I will honestly say that we overestimated ourselves and didn't add most of what we promised. However, we are still working on the level editor, which we plan to release in a month or two. Here's a list of all the new stuff included in this update:
[list]
[*]Support for gamepads (xbox, playstation and others),
[*]Several new levels with gravity shifting mechanics,
[*]New main menu,
[*]New final level,
[*]Fixed a bug with the save system,
[/list]
   
Hope you will like it!

notes.title: Squared Adventure is now available!!!
notes.content:
To be honest, making this game was a challenge for us, but as a team we gained a lot of experience, so I'm sure our next games (we don't plan to stop with this one) will be better and more polished. Maybe they will be something special for the group of a dozen people who will download this game.

Best regards to all who read this.
